thread:
maria: Quick sync — iterating the competitive battlecard for the launch posts + webinar. Need short econ soundbites vs cloud AI, crisp pain points vs LLM APIs, and an ops angle against infra vendors. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/s/benchmark-draft (please don't edit master yet)
aj: Love the structure. Can we get one-line TL;DRs for each competitor: 1) cloud AI 2) LLM APIs 3) infra vendors? Keep them single sentences for slides.
tom: @maria what benchmarks do we have that are public-ready? I can pull latency and per-token cost numbers if eng is ok.
sophia: I have QPS/latency numbers from the May run: avg p95 latency (1-token step) = 18ms on our hosted cluster, comparable open endpoint was ~45ms at same payloads. I'll paste a sanitized table later.
jamal: Suggested one-liner vs cloud AI: "Predictable unit economics at scale — ship with reserved serving, not spotty throttles." Short and punchy.
cleo: For LLM APIs angle: emphasize consistent output quality + carrier-grade fallbacks. Maybe: "Same API in dev, predictable performance in prod."
maria: Nice. We need language that sales can use in 30s intros. Also want a 2-line rebut for pricing negotiations vs infra vendors (e.g., "we remove ops overhead, you pay less than building in-house").
aj: Two-line TL;DRs (draft):
- Cloud AI: "Turnkey models but opaque performance — we give you predictable latency & unit costs. (Less surprise bills.)"
- LLM APIs: "APIs are easy to start, hard to scale — we give the same simplicity plus predictable economics and fallbacks."
- Infra vendors: "Tooling for hosting, not for production inference — we manage serving runtime, autoscaling, and SLOs so your infra team can stop babysitting."
tom: here's a sanitized benchmark snippet to use in the card (copy/paste):
```
Throughput: 1M tokens/hr (dedicated pool)
Median latency: 12ms (our prod, 16-token context)
Comparable public API median latency: 36ms (similar model family)
Estimated per-token cost: our stack = $0.0008 token, public API = $0.0021 token (normalized)
```
maria: perfect. Can marketing wrap the copy into a 3-bullet battlecard + 2 rebut scripts?
cleo: I'll produce the 3-bullet card. Quick ask: can eng produce a single-sentence caveat line for each benchmark? e.g., "results depend on seq len / batching". Sales needs that to avoid overclaiming.
sophia: caveat line ready: "Benchmarks normalized to 16-token average context and steady-state batching; results vary by workload and model family."
jamal: webinar hook idea: "How to cut inference TCO by 3x without sacrificing latency" — we can present a short case study.
aj: Love the webinar hook. Also add a live Q&A with infra lead — helps objections live.
maria: Action items:
- @cleo: finish 3-bullet battlecard + 2 rebut scripts by EOD tomorrow
- @tom: sanitize metrics and upload CSV to the doc (please include measurement methodology) by EOD today
- @sophia: add the caveat line and a one-paragraph methods note
- @jamal + @aj: draft webinar landing copy and 3-slide outline (hook, benchmark, customer playbook) by Friday
- @maria: I'll synthesize TL;DRs for sales one-pager

maria: Also: avoid the phrase "we're cheaper" — focus on "predictable economics" and "operational cost reduction". 
cleo: noted. Will use "predictable unit economics" and "ops cost reduction" language.

deploy-bot: doc uploaded: /s/benchmark-draft v3 (maria) :white_check_mark:

jamal: Quick objection script vs cloud AI: "They offer scale but routing, retries, and cold-starts create hidden unit-costs. Our dedicated serving eliminates those with predictable SLAs."
aj: +1 to that. Shorten for sales: "Their scale is real, but so are the surprises. We make costs predictable."
tom: FYI I added a small perf-methods appendix to the Google doc (lines on rig, model checkpoint, quantization).
maria: Great work team. We'll review the first draft in the marketing standup tomorrow and then send to SEs for field testing. If anyone hits blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
